segments.t: في صباح يوم الثلاثاء تستعيد الآنسة إيفلين حقيبتها الحقيقية بسعادة وتفرح بسلامة فنجان الشاي المفضل لديها، بينما تبقى الحقيبة الأخرى محفوظة تحت القفل والمفتاح حتى يوم الجمعة. استمع إلى المشهد الأول من الحلقة الثانية باللغة الإنجليزية.
Good morning, Miss Evelyn! Look what arrived at our gate last night.
My suitcase! Let me open the top pocket... yes, my red ribbon!
And your teacup inside? Is it still in one piece?
Not a single crack! Who brought it back?
We do not know. Someone left it on the step and rang the bell.
And he did not ask for his own suitcase with the wooden train?
He left a short note asking us to keep it until Friday.
How curious! The handwriting on that tag felt oddly familiar to me.
Really? Do you know someone in Portland?
Twenty-five years ago I taught piano near here, though memories fade.
For now, his bag stays safe under lock and key.
Wonderful! Now I am ready for a big breakfast.
